LePetit.app is the first mobile application for children and parents that contains audio stories and fairy tales in Bosnian languages.

The focus of the application is on learning correct speech, diction and building children's vocabulary. Therefore, all the stories were narrated by professional narrators and famous Bosnian actors and actresses.

LePetit.app contains well-known classic fairy tales as well as contemporary stories by renowned Bosnian children's literature writers. LePetit.app also contains  100 unique "therapeutic" stories by globally renowned Australian author Susan Perrow.

These therapeutic  stories help children to face challenging situations (fears, nightmares, death in the family, divorce, new baby, loss of a loved ones ...), demanding behavior (anger, aggression, boredom, disrespect, withdrawal ...), and everyday challenges and habits (defecating in bed, bathing, dressing, tidying up, challenges with food...).

LePetit.app contains more than 20 hours of quality audio content suitable for children 2 - 7 years of age. All content was approved by writers, proofreaders, child psychologists and educators, and over 20 well-known Bosnian actors and actresses narrated the stories in a perfect Bosnian languages.
